The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet is like a massive, chaotic library. In this library, every website is a book, and every web page is a single page inside that book. If you want to find a specific fact, you wouldn't read every book from cover to cover; instead, you would use the library’s index or catalog system to locate the exact book and page you need. Search engines like Google act as that intelligent index, helping you quickly find the specific website and page that contains the information you are looking for.
